newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open flat to off 0.20 cent.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open flat to off 0.20 cent.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open flat to off 0.20 cent weaker Monday as LME appeared set to retest $2,000 per tonne though some resistance was emerging.
COMEX stocks Friday rose 402 short tons to 31,431 short tons.
On ACCESS, December copper last traded at 94.10 cents a lb, off 0.25 cent from Friday's close.
Some traders expect a quiet session for the metals complex because of U.S. Veterans Day, a federal holiday.
A strike at Phelps Dodge's Candelaria copper mine in northern Chile has ended and the pit is working normally, a company spokesman said Monday.
The company added that production was hardly affected during the dispute.
